own_solution.law: Ohm's law with series/parallel combination and current division

notes: 6||12 = 4 ohm; total 8 ohm; I = 1.5 A; V across pair = 6 V; I(12 ohm) = 0.5 A. With extra 3.5 ohm in series: total 11.5 ohm, I = 1.043478 A, V pair = 4.173913 V, I(12 ohm) = 0.347826 A (= 8/23 A). Lamp circuit has its own cell, so lamp-attached resistors are disconnected; 'earlier experiment only' resistors are removed. 3.5 ohm sentences share number and unit; T272F and TBEF7 state no number ('small resistor').
